SUPERIOR COURT OF THE STATE OF WESTBROOK, COUNTY OF MARION
FAMILY LAW DIVISION

In re the Marriage of:
HOLLY E. WHITAKER, Petitioner,
        and
DEREK J. WHITAKER, Respondent.

Case No. FL-2024-00871

PETITION FOR DISSOLUTION OF MARRIAGE, FOR LEGAL CUSTODY,
AND FOR PARENTING TIME ORDER

Petitioner HOLLY E. WHITAKER alleges:

1. Petitioner and Respondent were married on June 21, 2014, in Marion County, Westbrook. The parties separated on March 1, 2024. The marriage is irretrievably broken.

2. Two minor children:
   - L.W., DOB 09/12/2016 (age 8)
   - O.W., DOB 11/04/2019 (age 5)

3. JURISDICTION: Westbrook is the home state of the minor children under the UCCJEA — both children have resided here continuously since birth.

4. PROPOSED CUSTODY: Petitioner requests sole legal custody and primary residential placement, with reasonable supervised parenting time for Respondent, on the following grounds:

   a. Respondent has a documented history of substance abuse (alcohol) including a DUI conviction on 11/22/2022 (Case TR-2022-7714) and an inpatient treatment admission in February 2023.

   b. On 02/16/2024, Respondent appeared at the children's school visibly intoxicated and attempted to remove L.W. from class. Marion Heights PD was called; report MHPD-2024-02-1108 attached as Ex. B.

   c. On 02/28/2024, Respondent was issued an emergency protective order (Case PO-2024-00318) following an incident in which he struck Petitioner in the presence of both children.

   d. Petitioner has been the children's primary caregiver throughout the marriage, handling all medical appointments, school enrollment, and daily care. Petitioner's employment as a school nurse provides a stable schedule aligned with the children's school day.

5. CHILD SUPPORT: Petitioner requests child support per the Westbrook Child Support Guidelines based on the parties' incomes (Petitioner: $68,400/yr; Respondent: $142,000/yr).

6. PROPERTY: Both parties acquired a marital home at 1107 Larkspur Lane (current value approx. $612,000; mortgage balance $384,000), a 2020 Subaru Outback, a 2019 Ford F-150, and joint checking and savings accounts. Petitioner requests an equitable division and exclusive use of the marital residence pending dissolution.

7. SPOUSAL MAINTENANCE: Requested in light of the income disparity and Petitioner's reduced earning capacity during the marriage.

WHEREFORE, Petitioner requests dissolution, sole legal and primary residential custody, child support per guidelines, spousal maintenance, and equitable division of property.

Dated: April 16, 2024
                                /s/ E. Hassan, Esq.
